# load tsv and prolific raw data
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
```

# load data
```{r}
# load subs
participants_fmri = "participant_wide_fmri.csv"
participants_fmri_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, participants_fmri, sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
L3_plain = "L3_plain.csv"
L3_plain_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, L3_plain, sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
```

# demean columns
```{r}
participants_fmri_df = participants_fmri_df %>% 
  mutate(age_mean = age - mean(age),
         Hum_Com_alpha = human_alpha-computer_alpha,
         Hum_Com_epsilon = human_epsilon-computer_epsilon,
         IN_OUT_alpha = ingroup_alpha-outgroup_alpha,
         IN_OUT_epsilon = ingroup_epsilon-outgroup_epsilon,
         Hum_Com_alpha_mean = Hum_Com_alpha-mean(Hum_Com_alpha),
         Hum_Com_epsilon_mean = Hum_Com_epsilon-mean(Hum_Com_epsilon),
         IN_OUT_alpha_mean = IN_OUT_alpha-mean(IN_OUT_alpha),
         IN_OUT_epsilon_mean = IN_OUT_epsilon-mean(IN_OUT_epsilon)
  ) 
```
